from tslearn.piecewise import SymbolicAggregateApproximation

# Initialize and fit the SAX estimator
sax_est = SymbolicAggregateApproximation(n_segments=4, alphabet_size_avg=3)
sax_est.fit(X)

# Transform the time series to get their SAX representations
sax_repr = sax_est.transform(X)

# Compute the distance between the SAX representations of the first two time series
dist = sax_est.distance_sax(sax_repr[0], sax_repr[1])

# Compute the distance of a representation to itself
dist_self = sax_est.distance_sax(sax_repr[0], sax_repr[0])

# Verify the results
assert isinstance(dist, float), "Distance should be a float"
assert dist >= 0.0, "Distance cannot be negative"
assert dist_self == 0.0, "Distance between a SAX representation and itself must be 0.0"

print(f"__CHECK__ distance_sax {dist:.4f}")
